applicability: Review of binding required-data declarations against the current diagnostic scope, under the applicable proposal contract. A declared future economic prerequisite must be distinguished from a current requirement.

A reference-checker rejection of valid authorized fact hashes is a service defect, not an agent citation error.
A reviewed process lesson does not establish predictive or economic value, or demonstrate improved agent behavior.
